takes.text: This comet is leaving the Sun, and its tail is in front.
Dust and gas stream off the head as it warms.
So what is pushing them the other way?
Sunlight presses on the dust, but only gently.
The gas is pushed by something faster: the solar wind.
It blows straight out from the Sun at every point.
So the tail always points away from the Sun.
The tail is showing you the wind.
